name: Revisions ES module outputs — atomic LFS hydration and bounded durable close; measured 108425 bytes brotli on macOS, 2026-10-21; cross-device chat handoff (XD3/XD4: a chat's checkout resolved from its branch and opened on demand, removed checkouts remembered on the device, and the turn-placement `publish` verb for a live run's heartbeat) about 0.9 kB, 109.32 kB brotli on Linux, 2026-10-23, then 109.42 kB with a missing branch waited on only while a remote syncs and an atomic removed-checkout record (limit raised from 108.6 kB to 109.6 kB with the owner's approval), then 109.70 kB brotli on Linux, 2026-10-23, with a branch a pull deletes recorded removed, a replayed admission answered before placement work, and a bounded wait for a branch's checkout to open (limit raised from 109.6 kB to 110.0 kB with the owner's approval); main's git HTTP client retry of 429 and retryable 503 (Hosted Remote Storage DA6) about 0.6 kB (about 109.0 kB on Linux CI on main, 2026-10-24); 110.23 kB brotli on Linux after merging main, 2026-10-24 (limit raised from 110.0 kB to 110.5 kB under the owner's standing revisions approval); the chat's record device id exposed to the host so external-agent markers stamp the id the chat segments sync under rather than hostname:username (which must not leave the host, EQ10(a)), about 17 bytes (limit raised from 110.5 kB to 110.6 kB with the owner's approval, 2026-10-25); the save path (push lag dated at push start, one push advertisement per attempt with stale refusals mapped to leaseLost, and a bounded parallel LFS upload pool) about 0.66 kB (111.26 kB on Linux CI, 2026-10-29; limit raised from 110.6 kB to 111.5 kB under the owner's standing revisions approval); batched, parallel LFS downloads on the open path (load-path audit fix 1: `downloadMany` and one hydrate per tree read) about 0.48 kB (111.31 kB to 111.79 kB brotli on Linux, 2026-10-29; limit raised from 111.5 kB to 112.0 kB, for the owner's approval in review); the open writes the checkout before its large objects arrive and fills each placeholder as it lands (the operator's "open the UI, model waits", 2026-10-29: a local-only tree read, a per-object delivery callback and the placeholder fill with its progress report) about 1.52 kB (111.79 kB to 113.31 kB brotli on Linux, 2026-10-29; limit raised from 112.0 kB to 113.5 kB, approved by the owner); its review fixes (a fill verified by hash and keyed by object so renamed and copied placeholders fill, a sweep on every flush and failure, abortable and stopped on close, resumed as the root starts, and atomic LFS object writes) about 0.54 kB (113.85 kB brotli on Linux, 2026-10-29; limit raised from 113.5 kB to 113.9 kB, for the owner's approval in review); I7 turn-lease execution holds, strict lease parsing, the held-checkout discard guard and closing-turn admission (Q9 I7 API revision 3), about 0.81 kB (113.85 kB to 114.66 kB brotli on Linux, measured in the merged tree, 2026-10-29; limit raised from 113.9 kB to 114.7 kB, for the owner's approval in review); the files service transport (`tau.lfs.transport` per download, the dominant transport on the LFS fetch report, download concurrency 24 capped at 32) about 0.23 kB (114.89 kB brotli on Linux CI, 2026-10-30; limit raised from 114.7 kB to 115.0 kB, within the agent band of npm-policy § 7); an apply publishes its new files with one bulk move (the cold-open checkout, Tau #1396) about 0.17 kB (115.17 kB brotli on Linux CI, 2026-11-04; limit raised from 115.0 kB to 115.5 kB, within the agent band of npm-policy § 7); the connect fetches only the authored refs and shares one advertisement, the export preference reads only tau.json, and native init is queued per repository (the cold-open connect, 2026-11-04) about 0.5 kB (115.66 kB brotli on Linux, 2026-11-04; limit raised from 115.5 kB to 116.0 kB, within the agent band of npm-policy § 7); the cold-open regression fixes (worker timing spans, large objects stored off the project's mutation claims, a byte-bounded single-flight fill flush, comparison captures that stop with their actor, and the apply/fill purpose on the host bracket) about 0.52 kB (116.18 kB brotli on Linux, 2026-11-04; limit raised from 116.0 kB to 116.5 kB, within the agent band of npm-policy § 7); the changeset apply path (W1: bounded changesets, temporary-sibling sweep, an abort that skips later changesets so moved files go back) about 0.4 kB (116.58 kB brotli on Linux, 2026-11-05; limit raised from 116.5 kB to 117.0 kB, within the agent band of npm-policy § 7); Tau's own pack reader and object store (W2: a native pack and index reader with integrity checks, a byte-bounded streaming repack under a fence, a compute worker seam, the tree codec and torn-write-safe control records) about 9.9 kB (126.48 kB brotli on Linux, 2026-11-05; limit raised from 117.0 kB to 126.6 kB, within the agent band of npm-policy § 7), then 126.67 kB with a pack whose bytes fail a read dropped like a bad index and healed by fetching it again (CodeRabbit on #1441; limit raised from 126.6 kB to 126.7 kB, within the agent band of npm-policy § 7); the supervised compute worker (W5: a restart supervisor with typed crash failures, delta resolution, SHA-256, a bounded zip reader and grep on the worker) about 3.2 kB (129.86 kB brotli on Linux, 2026-11-05; limit raised from 126.7 kB to 130.0 kB, within the agent band of npm-policy § 7); then 132.62 kB with the cold open's client half (a remote pack read by coalesced Range waves through its stored index, the object import, read-through and openBlob, the pack ceiling and the catalogue cold open, about 4.5 kB) and the review round's seam (byte verdicts typed at the source, heartbeat liveness, bounded in-flight calls), with zip decode and grep deferred to W7 and W9 (brotli on Linux, 2026-11-05; limit raised from 130.0 kB to 133.0 kB, within the agent band of npm-policy § 7); then 134.01 kB with the second review round (the upload-pack ceiling only where a catalogue serves the remote, a shallow boundary recorded and sent, the object-by-object import of a fetch past the ceiling, index-sized and counted batches, a 32-stream Range pool with an entry cut at the segment ceiling, batched read-through, and each fetched object checked against its id), about 1.3 kB (brotli on Linux, 2026-11-05; limit raised from 133.0 kB to 134.1 kB, within the agent band of npm-policy § 7), then 134.15 kB with the shallow boundary's review fixes (real parents outside the history walks, a boundary dropped once its parents arrive, read-through held beside the store, and the boundary re-read under its lock) (brotli on Linux, 2026-11-05; limit raised from 134.1 kB to 134.2 kB, within the agent band of npm-policy § 7), then 134.58 kB with the third review round (a catalogue import that keeps no tree, commit or tag before what it names, the commit a tag peels to walked in a cold open, and a compute worker that never loaded sending its calls to the fallback) and the inline compute writing to its transform's own writer again (jsdom has no `Blob.stream`) (brotli on Linux, 2026-11-05; limit raised from 134.2 kB to 134.6 kB, within the agent band of npm-policy § 7), then 134.81 kB with the staging bound of an object-by-object import (one batch of trees, commits and tags held with their bytes, the rest by id and read again when kept, and the peak on the report) (brotli on Linux, 2026-11-05;
